title: Organic & Hybrid Optoelectronics
foundationText: Organic photovoltaics, photodetectors, transparent electrodes, and charge-selective molecular interfaces are a foundation of my research. They provide a connected platform for studying how contacts and traps shape transport, with future possibilities in optoelectronic memory and sensory hardware.
homeDescription: Molecular contacts, photovoltaic devices, and photodetectors.
question: How do contacts and traps shape light conversion and detection?

paragraphs.text: Organic and hybrid devices provide a continuing platform for examining molecular contacts, thin-film electrodes, and charge-selective interfaces.

paragraphs.label: Published work.
paragraphs.text: First-author papers address self-assembled contacts and ALD oxide electrodes; collaborative work includes photodetectors and hybrid materials.

paragraphs.label: Methods.
paragraphs.text: SAM functionalization · ALD thin films · Interface energetics · Electrical / optical characterization.
